notes: Start with the manufacturer’s instructions because finishes and spray-face materials vary. For compatible models, wiping flexible spray holes or using a manufacturer-approved diluted vinegar soak may remove mineral deposits. Do not present vinegar soaking as universal for every finish. Avoid abrasives and harsh cleaners, and rinse thoroughly. If disassembly is needed, tell readers to follow the model manual and avoid damaging gaskets or threads.
